summary: Iter50 verified end-to-end. Backend 6/6 pytest pass: POST /api/contexts/{cid}/briefs returns final validation verdict (validated/qualified/flagged — never pending) at p95 ~5-15s thanks to asyncio.gather concurrency; brief shape unchanged {id, kind, objective, title, body, model, validation:{verdict,confidence,notes,validator_provider,validator_model}, created_at}; GET /briefs/{id} confirms verdict persisted; new GET /api/contexts/{cid}/minutes returns {items, count} with filename heuristic working — uploaded TEST_iter50_Q1_Board_Minutes.txt surfaced immediately; strategic-goals + briefs list regression intact. Frontend (live preview): /app/prepare shows three tabs (Brief/Signals/Minutes) with prepare-tab-{id} testids; clicking Minutes flips to prepare-tab-minutes-active and section header swaps to 'Meeting Minutes'; deep link /app/prepare?tab=minutes lands on Minutes tab; PrepareSideRail renders 'Past minutes' header + topic search + timeline chips (7d/30d/All) when on Minutes tab; AppShell sidebar nav items render immediately (14 items, no opacity flash); RecentActivity 'Questions answered' tile (data-testid=activity-cat-answers) shows count=3; flagged pip (data-testid=activity-cat-answers-flagged-pip) correctly NOT rendered because all 3 existing briefs had verdict=validated (per spec — pip only renders for qualified/flagged briefs).
critical_code_review_comments: prepare.create_brief still inserts with placeholder validation then UPDATEs with real verdict — two mongo round-trips. Could batch by awaiting validate_independent first then single insert, but the current pattern keeps the Gemini call concurrent with audit-log so wall-clock is fine. Keep as-is.

prepare.list_minutes uses {$regex: 'minutes', $options: 'i'} on name + original_filename. Without an index this is a collection scan; fine at iter50 scale but worth a compound index on (context_id, doc_type) and a text/regex-friendly index on name once minute counts grow.

Prepare.jsx initialTab IIFE is read-once on mount — if the user navigates within the SPA from /app/prepare?tab=brief to /app/prepare?tab=minutes via window.location, useState won't re-run. Acceptable since it's a hard-link surface, but a useEffect on location.search would future-proof it.

MinutesTab links to /app/documents/{id} — confirmed route exists in app shell; if Document Journal lives at a different path the testid prepare-minutes-item-{id} still works but the deep link will 404. Worth a quick visual confirmation.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_iter50 brief on Tuli Financial Group (CFO) context (kind=topic) and 1 minutes doc TEST_iter50_Q1_Board_Minutes.txt (the test cleanup deletes the doc, but only when upload returned 200; one copy remains visible in the UI screenshot for verification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter50 ships clean. Backend brief endpoint POST /api/contexts/{cid}/briefs now uses asyncio.gather(insert_one, write_audit, validate_independent) — final verdict is stamped via second update; observed p95 ~5-15s vs iter49's 25-50s. Minutes endpoint GET /api/contexts/{cid}/minutes treats doc_type='minutes' OR filename-contains-minutes (case-insensitive) as a minute. Frontend testids: prepare-tab-{brief|signals|minutes}, prepare-tab-{id}-active, prepare-section-{tab}, prepare-minutes-tab, prepare-minutes-item-{id}, activity-cat-answers, activity-cat-answers-flagged-pip (conditional). The flagged pip will only appear once at least one saved brief has validation.verdict in {qualified, flagged} — current Tuli CFO briefs all came back 'validated' so the pip is suppressed as designed.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs surfaced this iteration.
